description: A method call with no positional arguments passes caller data in two keywords. The first, login_error, must not bind parameter zero (`self`) and turn the receiver's application-owned hub.base_url into caller data. The second must not share that first keyword's position: it binds the parameter named username and reaches the command sink. The single expected finding therefore holds precision and recall together -- an extra redirect finding exposes the false self binding, while a missing command finding exposes a keyword that was dropped instead of bound by name.

expected.note: the second keyword binds the third declared parameter by name; it must not share the first keyword's fabricated position or disappear when that position is removed
